data.title: Iran’s Khamenei Says No Going Back For Middle East Rocked by War
data.description: Iran’s Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei said US military bases in the Middle East will no longer be safe after the war, declaring victory and a new regional order even as talks to end the conflict continued.
